name: yuan/admin-boilerplate
description: Development monorepo for yuanmaharsyah/admin-core and the skeleton app. Scripts only; no dependencies.

scripts.check:icons: git diff --exit-code -- packages/admin-core/resources/icons/lucide.json && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- packages/admin-core/resources/icons/lucide.json)" || (echo 'lucide.json is stale or untracked: run npm run icons in skeleton/, then commit it.' && exit 1)

scripts-descriptions.setup: Install the package and the skeleton, create the app and test databases, build assets. Safe to re-run: an existing APP_KEY is never rotated.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run every quality gate (spec §9): the package's, then the skeleton's composer check. Fails on the first error.
scripts-descriptions.check:icons: Fail if the generated lucide.json differs from git or is untracked.
scripts-descriptions.release: composer release -- {version} [--dry-run] [--yes]: split packages/admin-core into its private repo and tag it (refuses on a dirty tree or a red composer check; asks before pushing).
scripts-descriptions.test:release: The skeleton's create-project test (bin/release runs it after composer check).
